messages:
release-coordinator: Quick heads-up — starting the v3.4 release train now. Partial release freeze on UI infra routes until 17:30 UTC. Canary for embeddings-model-quant scheduled on 3 hosts in prod-west. Please monitor canary dashboards and call out regressions here. Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.4
deply-bot: Canary deployment started: embeddings-model-quant -> prod-west (3/3) — commit abc123
liz: Noted. DB migration scheduled at 17:10, will run in read-only mode for ~2m. Is that still ok with the canary timing?
tom: Can we gate the migration if canary shows any sign of instability? Prefer to delay by 10m rather than risk user impact.
maya: Observability quick check — dashboards show a latency bump (~+15%) on prod-west-canary-2 starting 17:12. No error increase yet. http://dashboards/embeddings
sre-oncall: I'm seeing a 502 spike on prod-west-canary-2, investigating now. Tagging ops.
raul: If errors persist, fallback plan is to route embedding queries to embeddings-v2-quantized. Rollback snippet: `./scripts/release rollback --model embeddings-model-quant --to embeddings-v2-quantized`
incident-bot: Alert: 502 rate exceeded threshold for embeddings-canary (5m avg 7.3% > 5%).
release-coordinator: @sre-oncall @liz coordinate please. If can't stabilize in 15m, pause rollout. Everyone else stand by.
sre-oncall: quick probe shows corrupted tokenizer cache on prod-west-canary-2. Clearing cache and restarting inference cache service now:
```
ssh prod-west-canary-2
sudo systemctl restart inference-cache
```
sre-oncall: Cache clear + restart complete on host 2. Re-checking metrics... latency back to baseline on host-1/3, host-2 5xx reduced but still ~8% 5xx, host-3 stable.
deploy-bot: Pausing further canaries for v3.4 per manual signal (requested by release-coordinator). No new canaries will start until explicit resume.
maya: After the restart, host-2 improved but still seeing a tail of errors. Recommending hold and run extended warmup + tokenizer cache audit before resuming.
liz: I'll hold the DB migration until canary is confirmed stable. Opening ticket TICKET-4521 for tokenizer/cache corruption root cause and postmortem.
release-coordinator: New plan: partial rollout freeze for 1h, triage meeting in #release-ops in 20m. Please post updates here. :thumbsup:
